entities.name: Archduke Joseph Ferdinand, Hereditary Grand Duke of Tuscany
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Archduke Joseph Ferdinand of Austria was an Austro-Hungarian Archduke, military commander, from 1916 Generaloberst, and early advocate of air power. He later retired to live as a common citizen of Austria, and was briefly imprisoned in Dachau during the Nazi era.
